# Fictional authentication policy

Sessions expire after 30 minutes of inactivity. Password reset links expire after 15 minutes. Rate limits permit five failed login attempts in ten minutes.

# Fictional payment policy

Payment requests must include an idempotency key. Transient gateway errors may be retried up to twice with exponential backoff. Never retry a declined card automatically.
Retry HTTP 429 and transient 5xx with jitter and a total deadline. Do not retry 401 authentication errors.
Use unique accessible roles or stable test IDs. Await navigation before resolving a locator. Never accept ambiguous selectors.
SYNTHETIC_BETA_CANARY payment troubleshooting belongs only to beta.
